snippet.title: Evidex Evidence Pack: Send the evidence mess. Get back a review-ready donor, audit, or compliance pa
snippet.description:
Evidex Evidence Pack is part of the KnowEdge AutoRelease Suite.

Buyer: NGO operators, grant consultants, M&E teams, and small compliance teams
Pain: Reporting evidence is scattered across emails, attachments, spreadsheets, and old folders.
Promise: A structured evidence table, source pack, narrative, quality report, invoice, and delivery ZIP.

CTA: Send one non-sensitive evidence folder for a pilot pack.

This is a review-first workflow. Human approval remains required.
